mechanism: Prednisone increases risk of osteonecrosis of the jaw and atypical fractures when combined with bisphosphonates; both drugs suppress bone metabolism through different pathways, and corticosteroids impair bone quality independent of bisphosphonate effects.
action: Monitor closely for osteonecrosis of the jaw and atypical fractures; ensure adequate calcium and vitamin D supplementation; consider dental evaluation before zoledronic acid initiation; use lowest effective prednisone dose and duration.
